title: Accepting a Change in Health
paragraphs: After an injury limited the sports he could play, Rafi felt frustrated for many months. He found it hard to accept that his body had changed.
An older relative told him that acceptance did not mean giving up. It meant adjusting his plans while trusting Allah through a difficult change.
Slowly, Rafi tried activities that suited his new limits. He found that he enjoyed some of them more than he expected.
A year later, Rafi still missed some old activities, but he had built a different active routine. He learned to move forward with patience and trust.
